name: time-of-day-greeting
title: Time of Day Greeting
description: A greeting that recomposes by clock: morning/afternoon/evening/night word, a gradient sky bar reflecting the hour, and a live minute hand of text — the heading itself is the clock, no icons involved.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Pastel

## Rules

- Clock Driven: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
